# Racial Equity Tools

> A comprehensive resource hub providing educational tools, frameworks, and community-building resources for advancing racial justice and equity work.

Racial Equity Tools is a nonprofit organization founded by Maggie Potapchuk and Sally Leiderman that offers a searchable database of racial equity resources, educational curricula like Transforming White Privilege, and foundational knowledge on anti-racism, structural racism, and intersectionality. The platform serves organizations and individuals working toward systemic racial justice.

## Key Topics

- Racial Equity
- Anti-Racism
- Structural Racism
- Critical Race Theory
- Intersectionality
- White Supremacy
- White Privilege
- Racial Justice
- Systemic Racism
- Decolonization
- History of Racism
- Internalized Racism
- Community Building
- Targeted Universalism
- Disability Justice

## Core Concepts & Fundamentals

- [Core Concepts](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts): Guide to core concepts including structural racism, intersectionality, and anti-racism.
- [Racial Equity](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/racial-equity): Documentation on racial equity definition and framework with Michelle Alexander and Robin D. G. Kelley.
- [Racism: Structural, Institutional, and Interpersonal](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/racism): Documentation defining racism including structural, institutional, and interpersonal forms.
- [Structural Racism](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/structural-racism): Guide to structural racism with Dr. john a. powell and Aspen Institute resources.
- [White Supremacy and White Privilege](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/system-of-white-supremacy-and-white-privilege): Documentation on white supremacy and privilege featuring Peggy McIntosh's foundational work.
- [Intersectionality](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/intersectionality): Guide to intersectionality featuring Kimberlé Crenshaw and the Combahee River Collective.
- [Internalized Racism](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/internalized-racism): Guide to internalized racism in communities of color with Donna Bivens' framework.
- [Race, Ethnicity, and Indigeneity](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/race%2C-ethnicity%2C-and-indigeneity): Guide on race, ethnicity, and indigeneity concepts featuring Ijeoma Oluo and Race Forward.
- [Decolonization Theory and Practice](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/decolonization-theory-and-practice): Guide to decolonization theory featuring Eve Tuck, Franz Fanon, and Linda Tuhiwai Smith.
- [Systems Thinking for Racial Equity](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/systems-thinking): Documentation on systems thinking for racial equity and systems change approaches.
- [Racial Equity Theories](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/core-concepts/theory): Reference on racial equity theories including Critical Race Theory and Targeted Universalism.

## History of Racism and Movements

- [History of Racism and Movements](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/history-of-racism-and-movements): Documentation on history of racism and resistance movements with Critical Race Theory context.
- [Overview and Timelines](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/history-of-racism-and-movements/overview-and-timelines): Timeline overview of US racism history including indigenous, Jim Crow, and slavery contexts.
- [Diaspora and Colonization](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources/fundamentals/history-of-racism-and-movements/diaspora-and-colonization): Guide to diaspora and colonization history featuring Roxanne Dunbar-Ortiz and African diaspora.

## Resources & Tools

- [Resources Hub](https://www.racialequitytools.org/resources): Main resources hub with searchable database of racial equity tools and disability justice content.
- [Glossary](https://www.racialequitytools.org/glossary): Glossary defining racial equity terminology and anti-racism language for dialogue.

## About & Information

- [Home](https://www.racialequitytools.org): Homepage introducing Racial Equity Tools' mission for racial justice and equity resources.
- [About](https://www.racialequitytools.org/about): About page detailing organizational mission, history, founders Maggie Potapchuk and Sally Leiderman.
- [FAQ](https://www.racialequitytools.org/faq): FAQ covering TWP curriculum, account access, technical support, and resource questions.
